description:
Implement parse_duration(s) in durations.py so it parses duration strings like '1h30m' into integer seconds.

Knowledge in force — cite by id: knowledge:258@v1 (All functions need type hints)
criteria: units s, m, h, d, w are supported case-insensitively ('2H' == 7200)
unknown units raise ValueError whose message names the offending unit
empty or blank input raises ValueError
